name: WhatWorkedBench v1 · Four-factor B=8
protocol: arXiv v1 Table 2; six original workflow families, d=4, B=8, delivered agent predictions, high reasoning. Dated API aliases, not inferred model snapshots.

summary.en: Tests whether experimentation helps agents predict the effects of component changes.
summary.zh: 测试 agent 能否通过实验预测组件变化带来的影响。

task_format.en: Predict all configurations after eight new measurements on six matched four-factor sources; original and additional execution cohorts stay labeled.
task_format.zh: 在六个匹配的四因素数据源上，进行八次新测量后预测所有配置；保留原始与追加运行批次标签。

explanation.en: Family-macro conditional-effect recovery from Table 2; missing submissions receive zero. Other budgets and post-hoc estimators are excluded.
explanation.zh: 采用表 2 按工作流程类别宏平均的条件效应恢复分数；未提交得零分。不混入其他预算或事后估计器。
